documented_probe: Documented probe waiver: C-b2fceb71 (feature matching + robust geometric model fits) has reference evidence at hard floor, but the v2 covering task exercises it at medium difficulty only. The verifier still fully checks the capability (hidden correspondence sets, degenerate cases); raising the task bucket would duplicate the photogrammetry family rather than add distinct coverage.
notes: Medium. One reusable CLI tool (/app/solve.py, strict <in_dir> <out_dir>) must (a) OCR a 9x9 digit-grid image into an exact numeric lattice, (b) render two arbitrary OCR-readable rasters, (c) render the recovered print-path and OCR a phrase off it, (d) transcribe the numeric parameters of a photographed Python algorithm and evaluate it, (e) isolate the all-caps secret token from OCR'd prose, (f) parse a plotter tool-path into its drawn primitives and dedeced its SEAL-encoded label, and (g) run three robust geometric-model fits (RANSAC line, ORB+homography, rigid) over noisy correspondence datasets. The verifier re-runs solve.py on the pristine visible fixture plus three fresh hidden scenarios (hardcoded shapes, degenerate zero-area primitives, heavy-outlier feature sets, distinct numeric literals and phrases) and compares every deliverable: exact digit lattice, exact secret/word/value/shape equality, inlier counts within tolerance, and that the two rasters and the recovered print-path are re-read correctly by OCR. Difficulty comes from hidden_case_generalization (re-run over 4 scenarios each feeding the fits and OCR), tool_breadth (Tesseract + OpenCV + NumPy + Pillow coordination), dependent_stages (a long shared pipeline whose intermediates feed later stages), and debugging_ambiguity (OCR/image noise and noisy correspondence are only correct when every stage behaves). No system services or dangerous actions.
